verdict.rationale: The xAI API uses versioned model identifiers (grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-imagine-video-1.5) and keeps release notes that record API changes. One note says an old slug is now served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with no change to the request or response shape, which suggests some managed migration. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, timelines or sunset guarantees, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods, explicit API versioning (e.g. versioned endpoints or headers), lifecycle and retirement dates for models, and independent corroboration of stability.
